title: Personal Action Reasons — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The reasons that can be given for a personal action — why an employee was transferred, promoted and so on. Each employee action records its action and a reason.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: PersonalAction
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Personal Action master data.
fields.html: What it is. The personal action this reason belongs to.
